# seerr_media_status (Resource)

Set a Seerr media item's availability status through `POST /api/v1/media/{mediaId}/{status}`. Destroying this action resource does not change Seerr media status.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "seerr_media_status" "manual_override" {
  media_id = "42"
  status   = "available"
  is4k     = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `media_id` (String) The positive Seerr internal media ID. Changing it replaces this action.
- `status` (String) The status to set. `partial` is only supported for TV series. Seerr can also report `blocklisted` and `deleted` on read, but its current update route does not implement either status for writes.

### Optional

- `is4k` (Boolean) When true, updates the 4K status field. Otherwise updates the regular status field.
- `triggers` (Map of String) Changing a value re-applies the requested status.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
